svg.text: Complete Entity-Relationship Diagram — Asset Management System (IR-AMS)
44 entities · 502 attributes · 64 database-enforced foreign keys · 36 application-level references · Crow-foot (IE) notation
Crow foot = many side of the relationship
Bar = one side of the relationship
Solid — foreign key enforced by the database
Dashed — reference used by the application, no FK constraint
Line colour matches the subsystem of the referenced (parent) table.
Every attribute of every table is shown; data types appear on the right of each row.
